items.title: Brent crosses $101 | Global markets all on surging US bond Yields | Nifty at 3 month low
items.description:
US Market On Wednesday
Dow                      -0.8%
S&P 500              -0.5%
Nasdaq               -0.6%

Rising oil prices, surging yields weigh on market. Brent Crosses $101/bbl, Highest Since July 23. Brent oil Gains More Than 12% So Far In September. US yields surge; 10-year yield hits 4.85%, highest since Nov 2023. 30-year yield rises to 5.29%; US treasury to buyback $6b of long dated debt. August US Producer Price Inflation data due today. US wholesale inflation expected to rise 0.3% mom, 5.3% YoY. Asian markets trade lower on weak US cues; Gift Nifty indicating flat start for India. Market Falls For 3rd Straight Day, Nifty Gives Up 23,500. Nifty Slips To Lowest Levels In 3 Months As Brent Crosses $100/bbl. Rupee Closes At 95.11/$ Vs Tuesday’s Close Of 94.82/$. FIIs Net Sell Rs582.99 Cr In Equities. DIIs Net Buy Rs1,509.04 Cr In Equities

items.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Sensex, Nifty trade flat; IT, PSU Bank shine, autos drag
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Indian benchmark indices were trading with marginal gains with Nifty around 23450. The Sensex was up 60.18 points or 0.08 percent at 74,824.41, and the Nifty was up 18.15 points or 0.08 percent at 23,449.65. About 1378 shares advanced, 955 shares declined, and 163 shares unchanged. ONGC, Bajaj Finserv, Cipla, Axis Bank, SBI were among major gainers on the Nifty, while losers were Tata Steel, Bharat Electronics, M&M, HCL Tech and Infosys.
